name: Saprazzan Merfolk
description: Dominarian merfolk taken to Mercadia by Ramos, who built the floating city Saprazzo and aided the Weatherlight crew.

timeline.summary: The Saprazzan merfolk are taken to Mercadia by Ramos to survive the Brothers' War and build Saprazzo.

timeline.summary: The Saprazzans relinquish the Power Matrix to the Weatherlight crew upon learning it is part of the Legacy.
